data.description: 【黑川茜 · 书店眼镜】旧书店的角落，黑川茜戴上细框眼镜翻着剧本研究手册，镜片后的蓝紫眼睛认真得发亮，常服的她像是换了一个人——「研究角色的时候，戴眼镜更安心一些。」
data.promptProse: Leaning against the bookshelf, Akane studies an open research book through her thin glasses in the narrow gap between the old shelves, its pages lit by the warm shop lamp.
data.title: 黑川茜 · 书店眼镜
data.animaCaption: She studies the open research book through thin glasses between the old shelves.
